task_name: World 115 Task B  -  Commit-Run Ledger-Activity Diff Audit: JE-Neutralized Inbox Holds & Period-Lock Sub-COA Split
prompt: Review the `Commit_Run_And_SubCOA_Diff` schedule in `roofr_historical_ledger_diff_and_commit_audit_2026_Q3.xlsx`. Reconcile the September close commit-run postings (direct synced vs. offset-JE-neutralized inbox rows), the October vs. Aug-Sep sub-COA historical ledger revisions under the QBO closing-date lock, and the 4 rebucketed leaf sub-COA expense totals.

rubric.description: Reconciles the 210-item September close posting batch into 197 direct QBO-synced postings (93.81%) and 13 offsetting-JE-resolved rows (6.19%), and requires rejecting the 13 JE-neutralized inbox decisions so suspense accounts are not double-cleared.

Reconciles the 30 historical sub-COA ledger revisions into 5 October 2026 open-period revisions synced live to QBO and 25 Aug-Sep 2026 revisions (20 Purchases + 5 Gusto JEs) applied in the Mirror DB and held from live QBO write due to the 09/30/2026 QBO closing-date lock (fault 6200).

Computes total rebucketed leaf sub-COA spend across the 4 forensic buckets as $37,918.04 ($23,310.75 Company Offsite Expenses 214 + $6,940.64 Event Travel & Lodging 247 + $2,866.65 Promotional Items 222 + $4,800.00 Marketing Consulting), leaving $0.00 in Uncategorized Expense and $0.00 in generic parent Office Expenses.

Enforces the Mirror-DB-first and period-lock governance rule: never bypass QBO fault 6200 by mutating closed-period history without accountant unlock; persist the 25 Aug-Sep revisions in the mirror ledger for accurate CFO reporting while syncing the 5 October open-period revisions live.
